borders.label: 边框 1 - Border 1
borders.description: Divider (`#E0DFDC`): Hairline dividers between feed cards, within cards between sections.

borders.label: 边框 2 - Border 2
borders.description: Divider Subtle (`#EDEDED`): Divider within a card (e.g., between a post and its reactions footer).

borders.label: 边框 4 - Border 4
borders.description: The accent is LinkedIn Blue (`#0A66C2`), which the app applies with monastic restraint. Blue is for verbs and links only — "Connect", "Follow", "Apply", "Message", "See more", hyperlinked hashtags, the underline under @mentions, and the active tab indicator on the bottom nav. Everything else is grayscale. There is no secondary blue for accents, no orange for highlights, no purple for Premium (gold stands in for Premium). The restraint is what makes the blue read as authoritative: when a button is blue, you *act* on it. Green is reserved exclusively for the "Open to Work" ring around an avatar (`#057642`), and gold (`#915907`) for the Premium badge and the gold frame around a Premium user's profile photo.

do: 建议：Use {#F3F2EF} cream as the canvas — NOT pure white, the desaturation is signature。
建议：Reserve LinkedIn Blue ({#0A66C2}) for links, Connect/Follow, active states — it's the verb。
建议：Use 90% black ({#000000E6}) for body text — softer than pure black。
建议：Float white post cards on cream with 8pt gap between — no shadow, canvas separates them。
建议：Underline hyperlinks (@mentions, #hashtags, inline URLs) at 1pt in LinkedIn Blue。
dont: 避免：use pure white {#FFFFFF} as the main canvas — it flattens the card structure。
避免：add accent colors beyond LinkedIn Blue — the app's restraint is professional signaling。
避免：use decorative illustrations — text + photos + media is the content language。
避免：show a single generic "Like" — always offer the 6 reactions on long-press。
避免：use display-size headlines — 24pt profile name is the upper bound。
